name: 挑战模式
description: Quiz challenge + world boss, migrated out of api/modules/challenge (P4.3b). Adopts challenge_records and world_bosses under their legacy names; reads question_bank and the legacy pets table (both owned elsewhere) through declared read access; appends to the shared point ledger only through classroom.public.

data._adopted_note: Both tables are written only by this domain and keep their legacy names because `SELECT *` rows for world_bosses go straight through to the frontend (max_hp, start_time, ... are part of the HTTP contract). Renaming is the coordinated P7 namespace migration tracked by guardrail G10. NOTE: api/modules/classroom/classroom.service.ts still reads world_bosses directly for its dashboard - that legacy reader has to become a classroom-side concern or a port when classroom migrates.
data._reads_note: Neither table belongs to challenge, and neither has a port: `question_bank` is authored by the system domain (CRUD) and cleaned up by admin, and `pets.attack_power` is the pet domain's legacy table - PetPort exposes no attack-power accessor, so the world-boss damage roll reads the one column directly. Both are read-only here; a write would be refused by the ownership check. KNOWN GAP (probe-verified): on a fresh *kernel-composition* database neither table exists - `ensureAdoptedSchema` only creates `data.adopted` tables and the legacy `initDb()` DDL does not run in that composition - so GET /api/challenge/questions and boss attacks answer 500 ('no such table') there until the owning domains migrate (P4.3c) or the host seeds shared read-only tables. The legacy/rollback composition is unaffected because it replays the full boot DDL.
